tagline.en: Robbyant's Apache-2.0 model for streaming 3D reconstruction — point clouds, camera pose, and depth from video.
tagline.zh: Robbyant 推出的 Apache-2.0 模型,面向流式 3D 重建——从视频还原点云、相机位姿与深度。

en: LingBot-Map is a 3D reconstruction model from Robbyant, released under Apache-2.0. It recovers scene geometry from imagery, producing point clouds along with camera-pose and depth estimates.

A distinguishing trait is its streaming and windowed reconstruction: rather than needing the whole sequence up front, it can process frames incrementally through the LingBotMap pipeline. In WorldFoundry the wrapper accepts either a checkpoint file or a local Hugging Face snapshot directory, and defaults to SDPA attention so it runs without extra dependencies; you can opt into FlashInfer when it is available.
zh: LingBot-Map 是 Robbyant 推出的 3D 重建模型,采用 Apache-2.0 许可。它从影像中还原场景几何,产出点云,并同时给出相机位姿与深度估计。
它的一大特点是支持流式与窗口式重建:无需一次性拿到整段序列,而可通过 LingBotMap pipeline 逐步处理帧。在 WorldFoundry 中,该封装既可接受 checkpoint 文件、也可接受本地 Hugging Face 快照目录,并默认使用 SDPA 注意力以便无额外依赖即可运行;当 FlashInfer 可用时你也可以启用它。

whenToUse.en: Reach for it when you need 3D structure from video or image sequences — point clouds, camera poses, or depth — especially in a streaming setting where frames arrive over time rather than all at once.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要从视频或图像序列中获取 3D 结构——点云、相机位姿或深度——尤其是在帧随时间陆续到达而非一次性给出的流式场景中时,可以选择它。

notFor.en: Checkpoints are external assets that you download separately from robbyant/lingbot-map rather than getting bundled, so stage them before running.
notFor.zh: Checkpoint 是外部资源,需从 robbyant/lingbot-map 单独下载而非随附,请在运行前先准备好。

en: Streaming and windowed reconstruction from imagery
Outputs point clouds, camera pose, and depth
Defaults to SDPA attention; optional FlashInfer support
zh: Apache-2.0 许可的 3D 重建模型
支持从影像进行流式与窗口式重建
输出点云、相机位姿与深度
默认 SDPA 注意力,可选启用 FlashInfer
